from.place: Proof, step 3 (blueprint proof, fourth paragraph): in characteristic p the polynomial T^p-T-u gives the Artin-Schreier exact sequence on Spec E.

title: Artin-Schreier exact sequence over a field
statement: Let E be a field [def-pc-field-extension] of characteristic $p>0$. On the small etale site of $\operatorname{Spec}E$, let $\mathbf F_p$ be the constant sheaf with value $\mathbf Z/p\mathbf Z$ as in [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and let $\mathbf G_a=(\mathcal O_{\operatorname{Spec}E})_{\mathrm{et}}$ as in [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. Define $\iota: \mathbf F_p\to\mathbf G_a$ by the canonical inclusion of constants and define $\wp:\mathbf G_a\to\mathbf G_a$ by $x\mapsto x^p-x$. Then $0\to\mathbf F_p\xrightarrow{\iota}\mathbf G_a\xrightarrow{\wp}\mathbf G_a\to0$ is short exact, with etale sheaves as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves].
